evals.expected_output: A new folder under skills/ with SKILL.md (name equal to the folder, pushy description), a scripts/ helper for the CSV step, and a fixed output template.

evals.prompt: review skills/wax_handoff/SKILL.md and tell me if it follows our skill conventions
